notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
BUG FIXES

 Fixed bug that caused zombies to get stuck at the first staircase
 Fixed a bug that caused the weapon in the player's hand to slip through walls/objects.


UI

 Removed ingame report system and replaced it with a Discord invitation link
 Version label updated to v0.2.1

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.content:
GAME

 Updated to Unreal Engine 5.1.1
 Anti-Safe Teleport System added
 Falling damage system added

UI

 Added a coin animation when collecting coins
 Added new level select system for singleplayer and multiplayer

NPC

 The Medic NPC no longer walks around but stands in a fixed place

MAP

 The Random World Generation has been removed
 We have added our first handmade map (World Wide West)
 We have hidden gold coins all over the map that add coins when you collect them.
 Added TNT barrels that explode when you shoot at them
 Added fixed spawn points for zombies
 Added Anti Safe system that prevents players from being in positions that the zombies can't access
 Removed the day/night/weather system
 Free purchasable barriers added

QUALITY OF LIFE

 You can now open the game menu when you are dead

BUG FIXES

 Fixed a bug in the lobby level display of clients.
 Fixed a bug that caused the zombies to always go to the closest player (as the crow flies) and not to the closest player (path distance)
 Fixed a bug that made it impossible to join a server after a match
 Fixed some bugs in the sound system, which caused that many sounds could only be heard by the client or server
 Fixed a bug that caused zombies to fly back and forth on the client when they died.
 Bug fixed, that zombies continued to attack dead players
 Fixed a bug that made it impossible to change weapons after a revival
 Fixed a bug that caused the hit marker to always be displayed when shooting
 Fixed a bug that caused a logged out player's weapon to not remove itself and instead remain on the ground.
 Fixed a bug where the XP from the server was also added to the clients
 Fixed a bug that caused the Weapon NPC to sometimes fly away when buying a weapon
 Fixed a bug that caused NPCs to still turn to players even though they were already out of range.
 Fixed a bug that caused the CoinsAdded sound to play for all players.
 Fixed a bug that could cause the stats menu to open multiple times
 Fixed a bug where dead players could heal themselves
 Fixed bug where players could shoot other players
 Zombies now ignore players who are in the safe zone

LOCALISATION

 German and English updated

notes.title: ToBas Zombies - Handcrafted Maps, Fixed Spawn Points & World Wide West
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259624/8ac05f583abeb51e98b117f9b6cec4e8615134d2.png

Dear ToBas Zombies Community,

We have been working hard to bring you the best gaming experience possible and we are proud to announce that our latest update is soon to be available. This update includes:

Handcrafted Maps: Say goodbye to boring, randomly generated worlds and welcome our detailed and diverse locations, designed with love and care.

Fixed Zombie Spawn Points: No more surprises on where zombies will appear. We have set the spawn points for you to better prepare your strategy.

World Wide West: Experience the first map of the game, set in a Wild West setting, and explore the world where zombies and players collide - a zombie invasion like no other.

Unreal Engine 5 Upgrade: Experience the best graphics and performance with the upgrade to the latest version of the Unreal Engine.

We are still working on finalizing the details, but we can't wait to release the update and see your reactions. Thank you for your patience and support and we look forward to playing together!

notes.title: Update v0.1.2
notes.content:
Update v0.1.2 for ToBas Zombies is here!

BUG FIXES

 Fixed bug that caused grass to spawn in the air
 Fixed a bug that made the DevMode accessible in the public game
 Fixed a bug that made it possible to start a mutliplayer session alone

OPTIMIZATIONS

 Shadow quality of all objects/characters significantly improved
 Player info refresh time in lobby increased

QUALITY OF LIFE

 The InGame Menu widget can now be closed by pressing the ESC key again.

notes.title: Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
Update v0.1.1 for ToBas Zombies is here!
After a long break there is finally an update again. We decided to do small updates instead of big ones. This allows us to react faster to bugs and also easier to implement new features or new content.

BUG FIXES

 Discord link renewed
 Fixed bug that caused Grass to collide with the clients

OPTIMIZATIONS

 Graphic improved
 Some improvements to the UI design

QUALITY OF LIFE

 The widget of the weapons NPC can now be closed with the interaction key (F)
 Added version label to main menu for better patch notes tracking

notes.title: Content Update #1
notes.content:
The first CONTENT Update is here!

Game

 Upgrading to Unreal Engine 4.27
 Added new images to the loading screen

PLAYER

 Fixed player being able to sprint while walking backwards
 Slightly increased aim zoom
 Improved player's shooting accuracy

ZOMBIES

 Added Mini Zombies - 10% spawn chance
 Mini Zombies can only spawn at level 1
 Mini Zombies are 25% faster than normal zombies but have 50% less life than normal level 1 Zombies
 Fixed Zombie Health Widget was sometimes visible when not targeting the Zombie
 Fixed a bug that sometimes showed 0% life for zombies even though the zombie was still alive
 Optimized animations on hit and death for all Zombies
 Optimized walk animation for normal Zombies
 Fixed a bug that caused Zombies to just stand still in the middle of the map
 Fixed a bug where Zombies could glitch into Players

NPC

 Added info text animation to all NPCs
 Bug fixed that the Weapon NPC sometimes didn't show the info text
 Fixed a bug that sometimes spawned the Weapon NPC in mountains or houses

World

 Fix Grass and Trees partially spawned in the air
 More grass now spawns
 World generation algorithm revised
 improved performance
 Added mountains in the background

Multiplayer

 Fixed a bug in the lobby browser that showed that it couldn't find any servers even though some were listed
